name: Claude Usage Observer
description: On request, estimates which Claude subscription plan you are likely on by comparing your session token usage to the 5-hour rolling-window percentage shown in the Ghola status line. Speaks only when asked.

planBands.label: Plan Bands (approx 5h token quota)
planBands.description: Maps a Claude plan name to an ESTIMATED 5-hour rolling-window token quota, used to name the closest plan during estimation. Anthropic does not publish per-plan token limits, so these are best-effort anchors — the RELIABLE structure is the multiplier: Max 5x is 5x Pro, Max 20x is 20x Pro. Tune these once you know your real plan, or tell TPM your plan to calibrate.
